preset.name: Desert canyon
preset.description: Authored canyon landforms around the GPX: sandstone formations and walls, a river in the valley floor, desert planting. The oldest kit (Blender regional models); no regional pack yet.
preset.terrainTool: authored: place "formations" and the "valley" by hand (or bake real terrain with build_terrain_grid.py and use "real-mountain")
